reason: I send the bank transfers myself, so my bank statement already tells me where the money went. I might throw the free 30 documents at it out of curiosity, but I would not pay every month for a sheet I can keep myself.
objection: If I find a duplicate, that is a conversation with my contractor, not a software problem, and I am not paying a monthly fee to tell me what my own transfer history already shows.
would_change_my_mind: If the free report actually caught a real overcharge or double payment on my build that I had missed, I would pay for the months the build is running and cancel afterwards.
